title: MEALS YOU CAN'T MISS

chapters.description: Cool rice noodles, green fish curry and a fistful of herbs
Freshwater fish steamed with coconut custard and kroeung
Peppery seared beef, crisp vegetables and sharp lime dip

editorial: The food is… something. Flavours are extremely pungent—popular dishes such as prahok ktis and fish amok both lean heavily on fish—and if you don’t like them, it sucks to be you. For whatever reason, there are also a lot of uncooked vegetables served on the side, and the grilled meats were underwhelming.
We suppose there’s a reason Cambodian restaurants aren’t taking over the world.
